author: Siva Sethumadhavan
summary: Every layer of tools/run_all.py passes on the synthetic dataset. The items below limit what that result means.

issues.title: No independent execution
issues.description: All validation was run by the package author's own tooling. No independent T7 execution or review has taken place (validation report NC-09 remains open).

issues.title: Manifest not signed
issues.description: baseline/release-manifest.json carries an RFC 8785 digest but no signature: integrity.signatureStatus is PENDING and no signature file exists. Both release approvals are PENDING.

issues.title: Synthetic data only
issues.description: The dataset describes no real facility, organisation or person. All capacities, tolerances, security levels and test outcomes are illustrative.

issues.title: Coverage 12 of 360 controls
issues.description: 12 of 360 controls are assessed (3.3333%); 11 are scored (3.0556%) because MCF-RES-017 is UNKNOWN. The score band is WITHHELD. The 348 unassessed controls, including every unassessed registry CRITICAL control, are carried as NOT_ASSESSED.

issues.title: Synthetic approval and review records
issues.description: ReviewRecords RR-001 to RR-006, including the APPROVAL records RR-002 (decision) and RR-005 (snapshot), were produced by tools/build_dataset.py. No human reviewed or approved anything.

issues.title: Registry status outside the record lifecycle (BI-002)
issues.description: The AIDCF-007A v1.1 registry status PROPOSED is not an AIDCF-014 section 11A.1 code. Registry records are imported as CANDIDATE with the original value in provenance.legacyValue.

issues.title: Gate ceilings derived from prose (BI-003)
issues.description: AIDCF-010 states gate ceilings as prose. failCeiling and unknownCeiling codes are derived by the AIDCF-016 section 9.4 rule and the prose is kept on each Critical Gate.

issues.title: Gate evidence requirement claim types derived
issues.description: critical-gates.csv gives no claim type for gate evidence requirements. The highest claim type of the gate's mapped controls is used; CG-11 and CG-12 have no mapped controls and use DESIGN.

issues.title: Supporting classes pending registration
issues.description: IACS, IACSZone, Conduit, SecurityLevel, FoundationalRequirement and Assertion are used beyond the 48 AIDCF-014 classes, pending AIDCF-014 registration.

issues.title: w3id IRIs not registered
issues.description: https://w3id.org/aidcf/ IRIs are used but the w3id redirect has not been registered; the IRIs do not resolve.

issues.title: Scope of the JCS implementation
issues.description: tools/run_all.py canonicalises the manifest per RFC 8785 only for JSON without floating-point numbers; it refuses a manifest that contains floats.

issues.title: SHACL fixture runs omit one graph-level shape
issues.description: Focused SHACL fixture runs exclude EdgeRecordShape (about 12 s per run) unless a fixture names it. The full-dataset SHACL layer runs every shape, and rule MDM-R10 is also checked in the BUSINESS_RULE layer.

issues.title: CI not executed here
issues.description: The package was run locally on CPython 3.13. The GitHub Actions workflow (Python 3.11) has not been run by the author of this release.
